question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to substitute the underlined word segment in the given sentence.

Mr. Saxena sold his car because it was a__ useless one.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **a white elephant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"a white elephant"** refers to something that is expensive but serves no useful purpose or is considered a burden. (बोझ या अनुपयोगी चीज)

 
 
• **Example:** The government building turned out to be a white elephant as it remained unused for years.
 
 
 
• The given sentence refers to the car being a "useless one," which aligns with the meaning of "a white elephant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **a white elephant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A gift of gab** (बोलने की कला): The ability to speak easily, confidently, and persuasively.

 
 
• **Example:** She has the gift of gab and can charm anyone with her words.
 
 
 
• **Bite the bullet** (मुश्किल स्थिति का सामना करना): To face a difficult or unpleasant situation with courage.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to bite the bullet and tell his boss about his mistake.
 
 
 
• **In doldrums** (निराशाजनक स्थिति में): To be in a state of inactivity, stagnation, or depression.
 
 
• **Example:** After losing his job, he was in the doldrums for months.

The correct answer is **Option 4**.</div&g
